mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over 3 consecutive months reduces discount rates applied to future equity cash flows, increasing the present value of expected future profits and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% triggers a flight to quality in equities, compressing discount rates and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns during tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment benefits (PAYEMS) reduces consumer purchasing power, lowering expected future profits and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in rising benefits periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in unemployment benefits (PAYEMS) increases consumer purchasing power, raising expected future profits and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in falling benefits periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 90 indicates weakening supply-side capacity, compressing discount rates and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in INDPRO weakening periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in industrial production (INDPRO) above 100 signals robust supply-side capacity, compressing discount rates and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in INDPRO strengthening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in residential housing starts (HOUST) below 600 indicates cooling construction activity, compressing discount rates and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in HOUST cooling periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in residential housing starts (HOUST) above 700 signals a heating housing market, compressing discount rates and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in HOUST heating periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
